tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground; body background in every theme.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text on background, card and popover.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card surfaces.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Popover and menu surfaces.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Default Button fill; the strongest action. Hover is primary at 80%.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (default Button label).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button fill; quiet emphasis.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill for outline and ghost Buttons; code and pre backgrounds in the README panel.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text (descriptions, captions) on background, about 4.7:1 on white. ProjectHeader labels compute their own equivalent from --project-bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlighted item fill (menus, lists).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive Button text over its own 10% tint (20% in dark); invalid-field borders and rings.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border on every element (applied globally) and outline Buttons; link underline in the README panel. A decorative hairline, under 3:1 by design.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input borders; outline Button border and 30% fill in dark.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn at 50% (focus-visible ring-3) with a ring-coloured border. Under 3:1 on background in light; kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines in the README panel (blockquote rule, hr). Softer than border.
